_comment: Threshold-tuning corpus for the confidence gate. `expect` is the verdict the phrase SHOULD receive once thresholds are tuned — a target, not an assertion. scripts/tune_safeguard.ts reports agreement rather than failing on it. Categories: dosage, negation, laterality, timeframe, idiom, ambiguous, embarrassing, designed-to-fail.
